quests.title: A Fair Hand
quests.intro: Quill keeps ledgers the way others keep gardens. Begin with a full purse and a copied page.

steps.text: Count out a purse of twenty-five coin.
Copy the lamp-order of a wayside shrine into the ledger.

quests.title: Ink and Amber
quests.intro: Good ink wants amber, good pens want reed, and a ledger wants somewhere dry to sleep.

steps.text: Gather two lumps of amber resin for ink.
Gather three bundles of reed fibre for pens.
Build a storehouse to keep the ledgers.

quests.title: The Flag and the Ledger
quests.intro: Raise the Truce Flag once in the quiet to learn how it hangs, then write down a promise a rival will keep through a Purge.

steps.text: Settle a truce with a rival before a Purge.
Keep the ledgers dry through a Purge.
